questions.question:
4A dice has its faces marked by letters L, E, A, T, F and U. Two positions of the same dice are shown in the given figures. Which face is opposite to face E?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/205a56c00e67b354a8a5a3e3fa4d23f8166740104b6fd01b75d73cdd957f75f8.png]
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As T is common on both the dices, it is clear that U, F, A, and L are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. E will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/349b1765abeebd0086569eb31f89d626f034652adafaec5cfad8060089754511.png] 

Opposite pairs:

U → L

F → A

T → E

So, the opposite side of "E" will be side "T".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark ‘(?)’ in the following equation, if ‘÷’ and ‘×’ are interchanged and ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged?

20 − 7 ÷ 4 + 20 × 4 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/952c967501c582f1911db7fefdaaefa9b6e3f505512624eb925e04e002be5a1f.png] 

Given: 20 − 7 ÷ 4 + 20 × 4 = ?

According to the question, after ‘÷’ and ‘×’ are interchanged and ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged:

20 − 7 ÷ 4 + 20 × 4 = ? ⇒ 20 + 7 × 4 - 20 ÷ 4 = ?

⇒ 20 + 7 × 4 - __**20 **____**÷**____** 4**__ = ?

⇒ 20 + __**7 **____**×**____** 4**__ - 5 = ?

⇒ __**20 + 28**__ - 5 = ?

⇒ __**48**____** - 5**__ = ?

⇒ 43 = ?

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some papers are books.

All books are shelves.

No shelf is a library.

Conclusions:

(I): Some papers are shelves.

(II): All books are libraries.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f3dcb1f046c7e5fab9269df293d398f47ddfce03e9177a4afca37d95cd40de5.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some papers are shelves → Follow (As some papers are books and all books are shelves. As some part of papers is common with books which whole comes in shelves, therefore it is true)

(II) All books are libraries → **Does not** follow (As all books are shelves and no shelf is a library. As whole books comes in shelves which cannot be library, therefore it is false)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (I) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:

'U $ J' means 'U is the husband of J',

'U # J' means 'U is the mother of J',

'U @ J' means 'U is the father of J' and

'U + J' means 'U is the daughter of J'.

Based on the above, how is B related to C if 'B # L $ C # Q'?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1887e263a0be106c3fc3bef05d4c58742c6a15e36b93bc74e9b8034e1f5d249.png]

Given Expression: B # L $ C # Q

B # L → B is the mother of L

L $ C → L is the husband of C

Thus, B is the C's husband's mother.

questions.question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

A _ P L _ _ Z _ L M _ _ P L M A Z P _ _
questions.solution:
Given series: A _ P L _ _ Z _ L M _ _ P L M A Z P _ _

Option 1) MZAPAZLM → A __M__ P L __Z__ __A__ Z __P__ L M __A__ __Z__ P L M A Z P __L__ __M__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 2) MZPAAZML → A __M__ P L __Z__ __P__ Z __A__ L M __A__ __Z__ P L M A Z P __M__ __L__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) ZMPAAZLM → A __Z__ P L __M__ __P__ Z __A__ L M __A__ __Z__ P L M A Z P __L__ __M__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) ZMAPAZLM → A __**Z**__ P L __**M**__ __**A**__ Z __**P**__ L M __**A**__ __**Z**__ P L M A Z P __**L**__ __**M**__ → (It follows the pattern of: AZPLM - AZPLM - AZPLM - AZPLM)

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

questions.question: Each letter in the word INJURED is arranged in the English alphabetical order. How many letters are there in the English alphabetical order between the letter which is second from the left end and the one which is fourth from the right end in the new letter-cluster thus formed?
questions.solution:
Given series: INJURED

According to the question, arranged alphabetically:

INJURED → DEIJNRU

Thus, the number of letters between the letter which is second from the left end and the one which is fourth from the right end in the new letter-cluster thus formed→ D**E**I**J**NRU → Four (F, G, H and I)

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

questions.question: Six people, Q, R, S, T, U and Y, are sitting in a row facing North (but not necessarily in the same order). Only four people sit between R and Q. questions.solution:
Given: Six people, Q, R, S, T, U and Y, are sitting in a row facing North.

Thus, Y sits third from the left end of the line.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
